note: #[route] rejects a Path<T> extractor that cannot deserialize the route's path parameters with a compile error spanned on the Path type: a tuple whose length differs from the parameter count, a primitive scalar on a route without exactly one parameter, and a same-file named-field struct whose required field has no matching segment (or, with deny_unknown_fields, a segment without a field). Maps, Vecs, flatten structs and types declared elsewhere stay accepted
